title: Integration updates: Segment, Mixpanel, and Pylon
summary: Three changes to how Frigade Assistant talks to the tools you already run.
body_markdown:
Three changes to how Frigade Assistant talks to the tools you already run.


**Segment.** Frigade Assistant now connects to Segment. Assistant events arrive as track calls: opens, questions, answers, feedback, Suggestion clicks, tickets created, and the rest. From there they go to every destination you already have connected to that source.


**Mixpanel.** Events sent to Mixpanel now carry more context. You can see which pages start the most conversations, and compare conversations that ended in a ticket with the ones the assistant resolved. Nothing to set up, the new properties are on the events already.


**Pylon.** When a conversation hands off to Pylon, the ticket gets a summary. If your team would rather read the conversation itself, turn on


**Include full transcript** in the Pylon integration settings and each ticket carries the conversation (up to the last 40 messages) in place of the summary. Off by default.
